readout_other: EMG of neck, tail and forelimb (triceps) muscles; latency, success rate, normalized peak EMG amplitude
direction_notes: Sonication of motor cortex evoked neck and tail muscle contractions (success about 81-82 %); caudal sonication gave larger tail EMG and shorter latency, rostral gave larger neck EMG; no lateralisation between left and right.
safety_notes: No evidence of any noxious effect of the stimulation at the intensities used; animals appeared normal after recovery.

exposures.label: Rostral and caudal mouse motor cortex, 80 ms CW at 500 kHz

target.label: rostral and caudal regions of the mouse motor cortex

timing.protocol_description: All experiments were conducted using 80-ms continuous wave ultrasound sonications. Sonications were delivered in pseudo-random sequence with a minimum interval of 5 s, only during quiescence in muscle activity; sham sonications at 0 W/cm2 were interleaved in 4 of 10 mice.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of 16 CBL-7 mice were employed in this study.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The ultrasound was generated by a single-element focused transducer (V301, Olympus, Waltham, MA, USA) with a diameter of 25.4 mm, focal length of 31.75 mm and center frequency of 500 kHz.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: All experiments were conducted using 80-ms continuous wave ultrasound sonications with an intensity of 3 W/cm<sup>2</sup> (0.2 MPa) at the center frequency of the transducer (500 kHz), settings we had found to be particularly efficacious in previous explorations of the parameter space for ultrasound neurostimulation (King et al. 2013).

flags.reason: Paper says only 'intensity of 3 W/cm2' and does not name the metric; placed under isppa by assumption. Calculated from hydrophone scans in a scanning tank, skull ignored, so recorded as free field.
Paper writes 'CBL-7 mice'; probably C57BL/6 but recorded as written.
0.2 MPa stated in parentheses beside the intensity; converted to 200 kPa.
Sham was 0 W/cm2 sonications; mechanism not described beyond zero intensity.
Intensity varied 0.7 to 3 W/cm2 only during site-finding; main experiment at 3 W/cm2.
